### 3. token efficiency in Claude/Codex This source contributes bounded operator tuning: - reduce unnecessary connectors and injected context - keep only the tools needed for the current mode - separate interactive and w

### 2. bounded connector and tool policy The merge strengthens the idea that tool or connector access should be: - job-bounded - mode-bounded - reversible - not assumed to be globally useful

### 3. anti-overbuild attachment logic The merge also supports a conservative attachment rule: - do not import an entire external runtime because one feature looks attractive - prefer feature-first attachment - preserve

### 4. output and context budget discipline The token-efficiency source adds a practical layer that the other two lacked: - context size is itself an operating surface - output size is itself an operating surface - worke
